Registered voters are more likely to say they'll vote for Democrats than Republicans in this fall's congressional elections by a margin of 4 percentage points, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's in line with the consistent single-digit leads for Democrats — usually low single digits — that Economist / YouGov surveys have found among registered voters over the past year.

August 11, 2026

Only one-third (33%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of how Donald Trump is handling his job as president, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's the smallest share to ever approve of Trump's job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump's terms. Meanwhile 62% disapprove of Trump, the most to ever do so.
